title: Introduction
text:
Dear Friends,
The ability to read and understand the New Testament in its original Greek can bring the keen Bible student a special blessing. Today, more and more Bible students are finding joy in learning to read the Scriptures in the original languages – Hebrew and Greek. This means not having to depend for the meaning of a Greek expression or word solely on second-hand explanations (however useful) in magazines, books or Sabbath School Quarterly.




By learning New Testament Greek you can begin to gain more Scriptural knowledge and first-hand insights, direct from the original Bible language. Learning New Testament Greek is not merely an academic exercise; it is a vital tool for deeper engagement with scripture, and the history of early church. It encourages reflection and personal spiritual growth, as well as enhancing our ability to communicate effectively both within our church community and to the wider world – our mission field.
Ultimately, proficiency in New Testament Greek can enrich our understanding of the Christian message and its foundation texts. (Naturally, though, learning Greek is not for everyone. Neither do you have to learn the original languages to find salvation in Christ full and free!)
Through God’s grace, a New Testament Greek course has been running for four years among a group of Lodge Causeway church members. Recently others have been enquiring about learning Greek to understand the Bible better. As a result we firmly believe the time has now come for other members to accept this challenge and start moving forward into a deeper level of the study of God’s word.
So, while we cannot start a new Greek course in church, we are encouraging members who feel led into this new venture, to start one of the self- learning courses now available - either online or by textbook or a hybrid of the two methods.
Broadly the two options are:

An online course with a one-off payment or a monthly premium, OR
Buy the excellent textbook ‘Elements of NT Greek’ by Jeremy Duff and a Greek New Testament. With this tutorial you can also view free back-up videos online. This is the method we have been using to good effect in our church for the past four years.













Source: https://www.amazon.co.uk/Elements-New-Testament-Greek/dp/0521755514



In connection with the self-learning course we envisage holding a periodic quorum for discussion on chosen Bible subjects and NT Greek word and phrase study.
The course will demand a regular commitment of time and effort, and the rewards begin very early. So, give thought and prayer to how God can lead you forward in service.
Then, if you decide, you can begin a self-learning course toward reading the NT in its original language, and begin understanding Scripture at a new level.
If we can be of further help to get you started, just come and chat to one of us.
Wishing you spiritual renewal in your ongoing service for the Lord,

Brian Martin (pastor, retired) brianemartin@virginmedia.com
Richard Timmerman PhD timmerman.richard@gmail.com
